title: HomeOps Diagnostic Pack (DKM-v2)
description: Validated, signed DKM-v2 execution contract for one appliance family. Compiled from corpus facts only (clean-room rule: raw manual prose is never emitted), signed by the pack server (Ed25519), and verified on-device before use. Schema mirrors dkm_v2_schema.sql (dkm_packages) and the dkm_compiler.py output contract.

schema_version.description: DKM contract schema version. 2.0 = current (matches dkm_v2_schema.sql).

model_patterns.description: Wildcard model-number patterns the pack applies to. '*' = family-wide.

exceptions.description: Explicit model exclusions (models that look like the pattern but must NOT use this pack).

region.description: Market region the pack is valid for. 'US' = US market.

facts.description: Fact-only knowledge: error aliases, test tolerances, part numbers. No prose.

kind.description: Fact class. error_alias = error code / fault alias; test_tolerance = expected value with unit; part_number = OEM part reference.

value.description: The fact value (code, tolerance, part ref).

unit.description: Unit for tolerances. Example: ohm, vac, psi.

model_scope.description: Models this fact applies to. Omitted = family-wide.

source.description: Source locator: doc title fragment or page ref. Example: 'Troubleshooting p21'.

procedure_nodes.description: Deterministic step sequence (facts-only step titles; kernel gates actual actions).

id.description: Stable node id within the pack. Example: step-001.

title.description: Step title (fact-level, no raw prose). Example: 'Water inlet filter check'.

action_class.description: Kernel-facing action class. Compiler default: observe. The safety kernel maps these to dispositions; never the LLM.

evidence_preconditions.description: Observations/measurements required before this node executes.

on_pass.description: Next node id or terminal action when the check passes.

on_fail.description: Next node id or terminal action when the check fails. Example: 'STOP: level 3 — call a pro'.

rights.description: Provenance block: source locators + clean-room basis (OQ-02 posture lives here, never stripped).

source_identity.description: SHA-256 prefix of the source document (first 16 hex chars).

prose_discarded.description: Clean-room firebreak: raw manual prose is never emitted into a DKM contract.

integrity.description: Tamper-evidence: manifest hash + Ed25519 signature. Verified on-device before any OTA swap; a tampered pack fails closed.

manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 hex over the canonical JSON serialization of the manifest (all fields except integrity).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the manifest bytes (hex, 64 bytes).

rollback_floor.description: Minimum schema_version a client must accept; guards downgrade attacks.

revocation_uri.description: URI to check key/pack revocation. Empty string = none published.
